churches.assessment: Northwest Chapel is a Dublin, Ohio Grace Brethren congregation founded by — and still pastored by — Dr. Terry Hofecker since 1985, four decades and counting. He pulls double duty as Grace Theological Seminary faculty, was a volunteer Police Chaplain at the World Trade Center disaster site in fall 2001, and serves as Project Administrator for biblical archaeology excavations at Tel Gezer in Israel. That's the resume of a serious pastor-scholar. The Charis Fellowship — formerly Fellowship of Grace Brethren Churches, renamed in 2017 — holds dispensational evangelical theology with Anabaptist roots: complementarian, biblically-inerrantist, mission-oriented. Two Sunday services (9:15 and 11 AM), recovery ministry, full lifecycle ministry portfolio. For a Dublin or northwest-Columbus-area man wanting a doctrinally stable, scholar-led Grace Brethren church with multi-decade pastoral continuity, Northwest Chapel is one of the strongest options in central Ohio.

churches.assessment: Winona Lake Grace Church sits in the Indiana college-and-seminary town that serves as the geographic hub of the Charis Fellowship — Grace College, Grace Theological Seminary, and the national Charis office are all in Winona Lake. Lead Pastor Kip Cone is Grace College and Grace Seminary trained, served almost a decade as a missionary in Berlin, Germany with Encompass World Partners (formerly Grace Brethren International Missions), and has been on the church's pastoral staff since 2006. The Charis Fellowship is dispensational evangelical-Anabaptist, complementarian, biblically-inerrantist. For a northern-Indiana man wanting a Bible-rooted, mission-minded Grace Brethren church in the heart of the denomination's institutional life, Winona Lake Grace deserves a careful look.
